zh-CN.title: VehereGo：实时活动与取件码中枢
zh-CN.shortDescription: 智能提取快递外卖取件码、机票火车票与 PKPass，灵动岛实时通知，万年历与课程表。
zh-CN.fullDescription:
VehereGo 是一款专为高效生活打造的纯本地、全方位实时活动与行程管理应用。无缝整合快递外卖取件码识别、机票火车票解析、PKPass 卡包凭证、桌面灵动岛实时通知、万年历黄历与智能课程表，让您的日程与包裹行程井井有条！

📦 智能取件码与行程凭证
- 自动提取取件码：支持截图 OCR 识别与短信自动解析，秒级提取各大快递与外卖提取码。
- 机票火车票与 PKPass 支持：自动解析行程机票、火车票信息，原生支持 PKPass (.pkpass) 数字卡券收纳。
- 一键生成条形码 & 二维码：告别翻找短信与邮件，打开即扫，取件登机更快捷。
- 驿站别名与智能规则：支持自定义驿站别名与智能触发模式，准确率更高。

🏝️ 灵动岛与桌面小组件
- 实时活动（Live Activity）：外卖配送、快递状态、航班车次状态实时掌控，锁定屏幕一目了然。
- Glance 桌面小组件：多尺寸精致小组件，随时随地查看今日取件、行程、日程与课程安排。

📅 万年历与智能课程表
- 农历与干支黄历：内置精准农历、二十四节气、干支纪年与黄历宜忌。
- 智能课程表与 ICS 日历同步：支持单双周、调课与课程重叠计算，轻松导入 ICS 课表。

💳 智能卡包与数字凭证
- 集中收纳 PKPass、会员卡、机票门票、优惠券及各类卡券，随时离线展示，便捷安全。

🔒 100% 隐私安全与纯本地处理
- 零账号体系，无需注册登录。
- 0 隐私上传，所有数据与 OCR 识别均在设备本地完成，绝不泄露隐私。

en-US.title: VehereGo: Live Activity Hub
en-US.shortDescription: Extract pickup codes, tickets, PKPass, live island & calendar.
en-US.fullDescription:
VehereGo is your local-first, privacy-focused central hub for managing parcel pickup codes, flight/train tickets, PKPass digital vouchers, live activities, universal calendar, and course schedules—all in one place!

📦 Smart Pickup Codes & Travel Passes
- Auto Pickup & Ticket Extraction: Instantly extract pickup codes, flight info, and train ticket details from screenshots (OCR) and SMS messages.
- PKPass & Barcode Support: Native support for PKPass (.pkpass) files and instant QR/barcode generation for fast collection and boarding.
- Custom Station Aliases: Personalize pickup locations and update recognition rules on the fly.

🏝️ Live Activities & Smart Island Widgets
- Live Status Tracking: Real-time progress updates for food delivery, parcel shipping, flights, and train statuses.
- Interactive Glance Widgets: Home screen widgets display today's tasks, travel passes, and pickup codes effortlessly.

📅 Universal Calendar & Course Schedule
- Lunar Almanac & Solar Terms: Precise lunar date conversions, 24 solar terms, and auspicious daily guides.
- Intelligent Course Schedule: Full support for odd/even weeks, course adjustments, and ICS calendar sync.

💳 Digital Pass & Card Wallet
- Store loyalty cards, membership passes, tickets, PKPasses, and vouchers safely with offline availability.

🔒 100% Privacy & On-Device Local Processing
- No Accounts Needed: Use all features immediately without logging in.
- Zero Data Upload: All OCR, text parsing, and data storage stay 100% on your device.
